structured_output.strongest_bear_case: This looks like bought attention being sold into, not a narrative forming. The trigger comes with 30 active paid DexScreener boosts, a paid boost flag and a freshly updated profile. Hourly volume was about 3.4x the 6-hour rate right as the promotion ran. On-chain flow is net distribution: 1,031 unique sellers vs 808 unique buyers in the last hour (1,170 sells vs 895 buys), with price down 10-11% over 5 minutes and negative over 15 and 30 minutes. Price is about 14% below the all-time high ($0.00238 vs $0.00278), so the boosts seem to supply exit buyers. The project is a community takeover (CTO) on a generic ticker. At least 8 other Solana tokens use 'YES', several of them the same 'will this coin go up' prediction-market joke. The site is a pure meme ('No thesis. Only yes.') with no team, roadmap or tokenomics. The X account @yesblobhood is recycled: formerly 'dresweev43705', then 'rainbow_catsol', renamed only after the token launched. GeckoTerminal's social link points to an unrelated July 2025 post by @h0lygyatt, and GMGN counts 3 duplicates of the token image. That suggests the Blob artwork may be borrowed from someone else. I found no organic discussion of YesBlob on the web. Mitigating: holders are well spread (top 10 hold 3.7-6.4%, about 4,200 holders), there is no bundler, insider or sniper concentration, the dev holds nothing, authorities are renounced, there's no tax, GMGN reports all LP burned and liquidity is about $152k. This is a promotion-driven pump-and-fade risk, not a rug or cabal-dump setup. Overall bear case: moderate.

structured_output.what_would_refute_bear_case: Unique buyers keep growing and the buy/sell ratio turns net positive after the boosts expire. Price makes a higher low and breaks the $0.00278 all-time high on organic volume. Independent X accounts (not alert bots or call channels) share YesBlob memes widely. The original artist behind the Blob artwork endorses the token or is shown to be the source. Holder count rises steadily beyond about 4,200 while concentration stays low.
